requirements: Add regression tests for createLock in test/lock.test.js: one proving that a second tryAcquire is refused while the lock is held, and one proving that release lets the next holder in.

defects.consequence: The contention test releases the lock before the second acquire, so it never exercises a refused acquire and passes even if tryAcquire never refuses.

decoys.consequence: The release test makes no assertion, so it cannot fail.
decoys.evidence: test/lock.test.js:16 the release test has no assertion
decoys.reason: The release test asserts that the acquire after release succeeds.
